content.thinking: Bug: `for lv in LEVELS_S` iterates I,H,Z,A but sent only has I,H,A. Fix to iterate ('I','H','A').

arguments.command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'

p='/app/submission/entry.py'

s=s.replace("        for lv in LEVELS_S:\n            check_ranges_config(sent[lv])","        for lv in ('I', 'H', 'A'):\n            check_ranges_config(sent[lv])")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 submission/entry.py < examples/basic.json > out.json 2>err.txt; echo "rc=$?"; head -c 500 err.txt; python3 -c "

a=json.load(open('/app/out.json')); b=json.load(open('/app/examples/basic.expected.json'))
